get.description: Retrieves an entity by its unique identifier.

canView.description: Whether the user can view this entity

canEdit.description: Whether the user can edit this entity

canDelete.description: Whether the user can delete this entity

canAdmin.description: Whether the user can manage entity permissions

canCreateChild.description: Whether the user can create child entities

_links.description: External links associated with the entity

_updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the entity's most recent update

_projectId.description: Set when this entity was created solely for one project — excluded from global listings/search, visible only within that project. Distinct from _projectLink, which associates an otherwise-normal entity with a project without restricting visibility.

linked.description: Whether the entity is linked to a project

isDone.description: Whether the entity is marked as done in the project

source.description: Free-form source label supplied by the updater

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp, inferred by the server

requestId.description: External request/run identifier, for tracing to an API call, job run, or AI generation

_externalMetadata.description: Latest external-update metadata, keyed by field id, for external_kind fields

_projections.description: Values returned by structured EntityQuery projections

schema.description: Complete entity record with schema-specific fields

put.description: Updates an existing entity identified by its unique identifier.

_projectId.description: Set to scope this entity to a single project; omit or set null for no scope
